question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word '__dwindle__' in the sentence given below.**

Rahul advised Neerja to appreciate or motivate her younger brother and not to dwindle or neglect his ideas all the time.
solution:
The correct answer is '**complement**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**dwindle**' is '**complement**'.
 
• **Dwindle**: to become smaller, reduce or diminish gradually in size, amount, or strength. (कम होना, घटना, मंद पड़ना)
 
 
• *Example: The river's flow **dwindled** during the summer months. *
 
 
 
• **Complement**: to add to something in a way that enhances or improves it. (पूरक होना)
 
 
• *Example: The flowers in the vase **complement** the color of the tablecloth.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *complement.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Deprecate**: to express disapproval of something. (अस्वीकार करना)
 
• **Motivate**: to provide someone with a reason or incentive to do something. (प्रेरित करना)
 
• **Neglect**: to fail to take care of or pay attention to something or someone. (लापरवाही करना)
